metadata.domain: High-Nickel Cathode Materials / Secondary Battery Materials

evidence.trl_pathway: All three technologies start at TRL 6-7 and require incremental advancement over 2-3 year timelines, which is well within industry norms for near-commercial materials technologies; no unrealistic TRL jumps are present.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio is appropriately focused on high-TRL, near-market technologies (TRL 6-7) consistent with 시장이익최대 strategy, with commercialization-oriented scoring metrics, though the portfolio is narrow (only 3 technologies) limiting market coverage breadth.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no explicit evidence of competitor positioning, technology differentiation rationale, or timing advantage design relative to competing firms in the roadmap; technology selections appear driven by internal metrics rather than competitive landscape intelligence.
evidence.market_timing: For 시장이익최대 strategy, completion should be within ±0.5 years of boom windows, but all three technologies exceed this threshold (0.75-1.0 year late), meaning they systematically miss peak market ROI windows by completing after the boom rather than at its peak.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: High market opportunity scores (4-5) are assigned to all selected technologies suggesting market signal awareness, but there is no explicit evidence that patent activity convergence was a deliberate selection criterion rather than an incidental factor.

strengths: TRL progression is highly realistic with all technologies at mature stages (TRL 6-7), minimizing technical execution risk
Budget utilization is perfect (100%) with zero dependency violations, indicating disciplined planning and constraint management
weaknesses: All technologies complete after their respective market boom windows, systematically missing peak revenue opportunities for a profit-maximization strategy
Portfolio is extremely narrow (3 technologies) with no competitive differentiation rationale, leaving the firm vulnerable to single-point failures and lacking breadth for market profit maximization
missing_technologies: 전고체 배터리 전해질 소재 (solid-state electrolyte) — high market growth area complementing cathode/anode materials
배터리 재활용 및 재제조 기술 — increasingly critical for regulatory compliance and material cost reduction in profit-focused strategies
코팅 및 표면처리 기술 for high-nickel cathodes — directly enables commercialization of T01 with differentiated product performance
investment_issues: Strategic tier assignment to T01 is appropriate, but with only 3 technologies and 100% budget utilization, there is no reserve for contingency or opportunistic investments if market conditions shift
T08 (실리콘 복합 음극재) has executability score of 3.0 and uncertainty of 3.0, yet receives High tier investment without explicit de-risking milestones noted in the roadmap
timing_issues: 고니켈 양극재 다결정화 기술 completes Q1 2028 vs boom Q2 2027 — 0.75 year late, missing peak demand window
양극재 전구체 합성 최적화 completes Q1 2030 vs boom Q1 2029 — exactly 1 year late, the worst timing deviation in the portfolio
고성능 음극재 (실리콘 복합) completes Q1 2030 vs boom Q2 2029 — 0.75 year late; accelerating start from Q1 2027 forward could close this gap
